meta.title: Jujutsu Shenanigans interactables data
notes: The current Interactables API lists 6 throwables plus billboards, vending machines, and the Unlicensed Rhythm Game. The older Trusses source text was not present in the refreshed API check, so this dataset uses the source-backed Shinjuku Station Control Panel from the current Map page as the tenth current map interactable.
Arcade Machine is intentionally one combined row: it is both a throwable object and the source of two $1 arcade minigames.
Soda is not a separate interactable row because the item itself belongs to the items page. Vending Machines stay here because the machine route, location, and cost are interactable behavior.
Vending Machines and Unlicensed Rhythm Game are intentionally image-blank because the available source media is a map-dot image or no clean row-specific image.

items.name: Garbage Can
items.location: Center Square, Shinjuku Station, Tze's, and Cafe
items.requirement: Stand next to it and use melee to pick it up
items.effect: Can be picked up and thrown as an environmental projectile.
items.baseDamage: 15 unblockable bullet-type damage while in motion
items.relatedMoves: Combat Instincts, Lurking Shadow, Boogie Woogie, and Severance Kick can interact with throwables.
items.verificationNote: Current Interactables API lists Garbage Can as a throwable with these locations and no special effect.

items.name: Fire Extinguisher
items.location: The 2 Towers, Shinjuku Station, Cafe, and Tze's
items.requirement: Stand next to it and use melee to pick it up
items.effect: Can be picked up and thrown as an environmental projectile.
items.baseDamage: 15 unblockable bullet-type damage while in motion
items.specialInteractions: Explodes into white mist when it breaks.
items.relatedMoves: Combat Instincts, Lurking Shadow, Boogie Woogie, and Severance Kick can interact with throwables.
items.verificationNote: Current Interactables API lists Fire Extinguisher as a throwable and names the white-mist break effect.

items.name: Chair
items.requirement: Stand next to it and use melee to pick it up
items.effect: Can be picked up and thrown as an environmental projectile.
items.baseDamage: 15 unblockable bullet-type damage while in motion
items.specialInteractions: Hits the target upward a little instead of normal knockback.
items.relatedMoves: Combat Instincts, Lurking Shadow, Boogie Woogie, and Severance Kick can interact with throwables.
items.verificationNote: Current Interactables API lists Chair as a throwable and names the upward-hit behavior.

items.name: Gravestone
items.requirement: Stand next to it and use melee to pick it up
items.effect: Can be picked up and thrown as an environmental projectile.
items.baseDamage: 15 unblockable bullet-type damage while in motion
items.relatedMoves: Combat Instincts, Lurking Shadow, Boogie Woogie, and Severance Kick can interact with throwables.
items.verificationNote: Current Interactables API lists Gravestone as a throwable and names the 5-second health-regeneration delay.

items.name: Arcade Machine
items.requirement: Use the interaction prompt to play, or pick it up as a throwable
items.effect: Can be thrown for environmental damage or operated to play Unlicensed Catch Game and Unlicensed Flight Game.
items.baseDamage: 15 unblockable bullet-type damage while in motion
items.specialInteractions: Explodes into coins when it breaks. It can still be picked up while someone is playing it.
items.relatedMoves: Combat Instincts, Lurking Shadow, Boogie Woogie, and Severance Kick can interact with throwables. Arcade play connects to a daily quest and related emotes.
items.availability: Current source-backed throwable and arcade prompt
items.verificationNote: Combined row approved in Phase 2. Interactables lists throwable and minigame behavior; Shop confirms Cash use and daily-quest context.

items.name: Piano
items.requirement: Use the interaction prompt to sit and play, or pick it up as a throwable
items.effect: Can be thrown for environmental damage or used as a playable piano with basic and more complicated notes.
items.baseDamage: 15 unblockable bullet-type damage while in motion
items.specialInteractions: Plays an unpleasant chord when it breaks. It can still be picked up while someone is playing it.
items.relatedMoves: Combat Instincts, Lurking Shadow, Boogie Woogie, and Severance Kick can interact with throwables. The normal play behavior overlaps the Piano emote controls.
items.availability: Current source-backed throwable and piano prompt
items.itemsPageOverlap: No current items-page row; overlaps emote behavior instead
items.verificationNote: Current Interactables API lists Piano as a throwable with Stage and Karaoke locations. Map page also names an interactable piano in the Comedy Club.

items.name: Billboards
items.location: Two towers, with editing panels on the fourth floors
items.requirement: Kill requirement listed by the source
items.effect: Displays a custom image ID and the name of the last player who edited the billboard.
items.specialInteractions: The edit panel warns that inappropriate images can result in a ban.
items.verificationNote: Current Interactables API says there are 2 billboards, one on each tower, and Map confirms tower panels.

items.name: Vending Machines
items.location: In or outside buildings and in Shinjuku Station
items.effect: Lets players buy Soda from the machine.
items.specialInteractions: Soda is the item created by the interaction. The vending-machine object itself is the interactable row.
items.relatedMoves: Soda overlaps the items page. No current source-backed character move interaction is listed for the vending-machine row.
items.itemsPageOverlap: Creates Soda, which is owned by the items page
items.sourcePage: Jujutsu Shenanigans Wiki - Interactables; Items; Map
items.imageMissingReason: The source image is a vending-machine dot map instead of a clean row-specific object image, so the card is intentionally left blank.
items.verificationNote: Interactables confirms V1.37 proximity-prompt Soda purchase for $5. Items confirms Soda remains the held item.

items.name: Shinjuku Station Control Panel
items.requirement: Use one of the station control-panel buttons
items.effect: One button broadcasts to the subway station, and another calls a speeding train on the rails.
items.baseDamage: Train heavily damages players in its way; exact damage is not listed
items.specialInteractions: The train travels along the station rails after being called.
items.verificationNote: Added after refreshed source review because the current Interactables API no longer includes the older Trusses section. Map source clearly describes this as an interactable station mechanism.

items.name: Unlicensed Rhythm Game
items.requirement: Interact with the karaoke machine and pick a song snippet
items.effect: Starts a Yakuza-style rhythm game and displays the player's score when it ends.
items.specialInteractions: The user gains full i-frames while performing.
items.imageMissingReason: No clean row-specific source image was available for the karaoke machine or rhythm-game UI in this pass.
items.verificationNote: Current Interactables API lists the karaoke machine route, song-snippet behavior, i-frames, and score display.
